Without C4, the logistic R2=1.0 PASS (spec.json C1/C3) is purely in-sample interpolation of 4 points with 3 parameters and provides zero extrapolation power beyond F(n)=0.5654 for all n>=15. The SURVIVES verdict is scientifically vacuous as written.

Do not cite C1/C3 PASS (R2=1.0, max residual 3.78e-08pp) as evidence of validated extrapolation. With 4 training points and 3 free parameters (logistic L/k/n0, Hill L/h/K), perfect interpolation is structurally guaranteed when data is step-like (0,0,0.4996,0.5654). Report AIC/BIC but also report leave-one-out or extrapolation hold-out diagnostics; with n=20 as the sole non-zero asymptote informant, L is entirely determined by one observation.

Treat Hill h=20.0 at upper bound as degenerate/boundary hit, not as validated fit. Bounds were [0.1,20] for h and [0,1] for L; Hill converges at h=20.0 exactly at the bound with R2=0.999994 and F50=0.565659 (0.03pp from null).
